topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I heard tell of an artist, one who paints the world with colors few can see. They found their work, a mare's tale tells me, branded into someone's skin. Can you imagine? A work, meant for all to see, now worn like a banner by one soul. It ain't right, to take such beauty and cage it so. The world's got enough sorrow, what with the rain that soaks the fields when the wheat's nearly ripe, or the way the miller's wife went when the spring cold lingered too long. This, this is just another kind of loss, a piece of beauty taken and twisted. The artist, they say, was as still as the stone saints in the church, the day they learned of it.
